connections.why: The two AS themes share family, leisure and media vocabulary that recur across speaking tasks
The prepared presentation leads directly into the spontaneous conversation in the same exam
Listening passages are set on the same AS themes practised orally
Reading comprehension skills underpin accurate translation of a French passage into English
Grammar drilled in Use of Language is applied for accuracy in extended writing
Close reading skills transfer to handling quotations and detail from the set work
A successful essay depends on a wide, accurate range of structures
AS conversation technique is the foundation for the longer, more demanding A2 discussion
AS listening prepares learners for the harder, faster A2 listening tasks
Rendering French meaning into English underpins the A2 summary task
Translating phrases into French at AS builds toward the full English-to-French translation at A2
AS essay writing on a set work develops into the more analytical A2 critical essay
The two A2 themes overlap on citizenship, society and global responsibility
The research discussion and the wider conversation are assessed together in the A2 speaking exam
A2 reading texts draw on the same societal and global issues discussed orally
Accurate comprehension of the source text is required before it can be summarised
Advanced reading of the set work feeds the evidence and analysis in the critical essay
The critical essay is built on genuine analysis and a personal response to the work
Presenting and defending a prepared topic at AS scaffolds the independent research discussion at A2
Grammatical accuracy from AS writing is essential for translating into idiomatic French
